ParentInstance.description: Settings for building on an instance that is already running, instead of an instance that Image Builder launches for the build.

AutoScalingGroup.description: The Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group that Image Builder takes the build instance from.
Identifies the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group that Image Builder takes the build instance from, and how long Image Builder waits when the group has no instance available.

Name.description: The name of the Auto Scaling group, in the same account and AWS Region as the infrastructure configuration.

CapacityWaitTimeoutSeconds.description: The number of seconds that Image Builder waits for an instance to become available in the group before the build fails. If you set this value to 0 or omit it, the build fails as soon as the group has no instance available.
